data.name: George
data.gender_notes: George is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek geōrgos, 'farmer', from gē, 'earth', + ergon, 'work'. Its root is Greek geōrgos (γεωργός). Saint George, the dragon-slayer and martyr. George is a Greek name meaning “Farmer; earth-worker”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: George expresses “Farmer; earth-worker”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek geōrgos, 'farmer', from gē, 'earth', + ergon, 'work'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of George total 39, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
